decisions.decision: TuningEngine declared in global namespace (no Ouaricon:: prefix) in voice + processor
decisions.rationale: Matches how scala-tuning-engine module exposes the class via Pattern B (direct target_sources) — class is declared at global scope in TuningEngine.h. The Ouaricon:: prefix would force a forward-declaration mismatch.
alternatives: Wrap in Ouaricon namespace alias (forces module header changes)

decisions.decision: ouaricon_add_module(O-Bassoon note-expression) only; no target_link_libraries(... PRIVATE Ouaricon::note_expression) line
decisions.rationale: ouaricon_add_module() applies the JUCE-NE-PATCH and adds sources directly to the target; an additional target_link_libraries call would double-link and trigger duplicate symbol errors.

decisions.decision: Both NEEDS_WEBVIEW2 TRUE and JUCE_USE_WIN_WEBVIEW2_WITH_STATIC_LINKING=1 set at Stage 1
decisions.rationale: Avoids the WebView silent-blank-page bug on Windows (CLAUDE.md memory: dynamic loader looks for WebView2Loader.dll which is not distributed). Stage 3 GUI will use WebView; baking the flags in early prevents a Stage 3 build-system regression.
alternatives: Defer flags to Stage 3 (risks shipping a blank-page WebView build)

decisions.decision: 16 voices pre-allocated in OBassoonAudioProcessor ctor (not on first noteOn)
decisions.rationale: JUCE 8 allows allocating Synthesiser voices in constructor; doing this once eliminates first-note allocation latency and matches O-Wind/O-Lyrica precedent.
alternatives: Lazy voice allocation in prepareToPlay (more complex bookkeeping)
